name: YouTube Stats
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Display YouTube channel statistics including subscriber count, total views, and channel name on your LED matrix

api_requirements.name: YouTube Data API v3
api_requirements.description: YouTube Data API for fetching channel statistics

versions.changelog: update_interval works below 300 seconds. The core scheduled update() at the manifest's 300 seconds and ignored a shorter configured interval, so the 60-second floor the README describes was unreachable; the plugin now returns the configured value from get_update_interval(). A web-UI change to update_interval applies without a restart. Requires LEDMatrix core 3.4.0, the first with the get_update_interval() hook; the store now refuses the install on older cores (on those the setting would stay ignored).

Channels that hide their subscriber count now display, shown as 'subs hidden', instead of failing to parse. The first frame no longer calls the YouTube API from display(); it draws 'Loading' and update() fetches. The missing-stats warning is logged when it changes or every five minutes instead of every frame, and that state now draws 'No data' instead of nothing.
Render text 1-bit (no anti-aliasing) so glyphs stay crisp on the LED grid

versions.notes: Load a bitmap font at its own pixel size. A .bdf exists at exactly one pixel size and FreeType rejects any other, so every .bdf in the font picker failed at the configured font_size and silently fell back to the default face -- choosing one appeared to do nothing. Bitmap faces are now retried at the size the file's PIXEL_SIZE header declares. Same fix already landed for clock-simple, news and tide-display, which share this loader.
changes: Documented the nine customization settings, which were absent, and added rendered examples of the card, the font and colour options, and four panel sizes.

versions.notes: Load a bitmap font at its own pixel size. A .bdf exists at exactly one pixel size and FreeType rejects any other, so every .bdf in the font picker failed at the configured font_size and silently fell back to the default face -- choosing one appeared to do nothing. Bitmap faces are now retried at the size the file's PIXEL_SIZE header declares. Same fix already landed for clock-simple, news and tide-display, which share this loader.

Stop retrying a failing YouTube API once per rendered frame. display() re-ran update() whenever channel_stats was empty, and update() leaves it empty on any failure, so a bad key or an exhausted quota produced one requests.get(timeout=10) per frame on the render thread. display() now gates on whether a fetch was attempted rather than on its result, and update() is throttled to update_interval, so a broken API costs one request per interval instead of one per frame.

Fix a blank-screen bug: an unconfigured API key or channel ID left the display fully blank with no on-screen indication, since only the invalid/expired-key path set the error state that display() checks. Both missing-config cases now show the same on-screen 'YT: Update API Key' message the expired-key case already did.
